root_cause.text: In `cgroup_migrate_add_task()`, a task is moved from `cset->tasks` to `cset->mg_tasks` before updating active `css_task_iter` iterators pointing to it, which causes the iterators to advance relative to the `mg_tasks` list instead of the original `tasks` list and skip remaining tasks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `css_set_skip_task_iters(cset, task)` before `list_move_tail(&task->cg_list, &cset->mg_tasks)` in `cgroup_migrate_add_task()`. The commit message explains that when a task is moved to `mg_tasks` first, "the iterator is advanced relative to the mg_tasks list instead of the original tasks list. As a result, remaining tasks on cset->tasks, as well as tasks queued on cset->mg_tasks, can be skipped by iteration."
